users.name: Users
users.blurb: Where traffic starts. A domain resolves to one host, so Users take one link.

payments.name: Payments
payments.blurb: Revenue waits here. The drawer holds about a minute of it.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.blurb: Link any Node into it. It samples that traffic and turns it into Insight.

server.name: App Server
server.blurb: Runs your code. Answers requests and sends queries to the database.

database.name: Database
database.blurb: The source of truth. Postgres reads and scans cheaper; MySQL writes cheaper and changes schema online.

dns.name: DNS
dns.blurb: Round robin across up to 8 hosts. No health checks: a dead host keeps its share.

lb.name: Load Balancer
lb.blurb: Splits traffic across App Servers or Database hosts and drops a dead host at its next health check.

pooler.name: Connection Pooler
pooler.blurb: Many app connections share 20 database connections. It pools to one host.

cache.name: Cache
cache.blurb: Answers read queries from memory while the hot data fits. Writes pass through and invalidate.

replica.name: Read Replica
replica.blurb: Answers reads from a copy. Lags behind writes, so some API reads come back stale.

auth.name: Auth Provider
auth.blurb: Hashes passwords for you. Charged per user.

search.name: Search Engine
search.blurb: Answers search queries. 400 per second per size step.

storage.name: Object Storage
storage.blurb: Holds uploaded files. No limit. Pay for what it stores.

doc.name: Document Store
doc.blurb: Holds documents instead of rows. No joins and no connections to pool: one flat rate of reads and writes, and each query needs its own index.

queue.name: Queue
queue.blurb: Takes work now so Workers can do it later. Users wait only for the enqueue.

worker.name: Worker
worker.blurb: Runs your code on tasks from a Queue. Users never wait for it. Link it to the data an export reads.

log.name: Event Stream
log.blurb: A log, not a queue: events stay after they are read, so a consumer can replay them. Consumers read one partition each and fall behind at their own pace.

fn.name: Serverless Function
fn.blurb: Runs your code per request with no box to pay for: nothing while it idles, a cold start when it has, and 1,000 executions at once.

cdn.name: CDN
cdn.blurb: Answers cacheable pages near the user. Egress from the edge costs less.

waf.name: WAF
waf.blurb: Blocks bots before they reach the app, and some real users with them.

gw.name: API Gateway
gw.blurb: Rate-limits and routes API calls. Past its rate limit, requests fail as throttled, and it bills per request.

ws.name: Realtime Hub
ws.blurb: Holds a connection open for every realtime message. How many fit depends on the runtime.

psp.name: Payment Provider
psp.blurb: Charges cards for checkouts. 2.9% plus $0.30 per checkout.

autoscaler.name: Autoscaler
autoscaler.blurb: Link App Servers or Workers into it. It adds copies when they run hot and removes them when idle.

ci.name: CI/CD Pipeline
ci.blurb: Ships what waits. Its deploy strategy sets how long a deploy takes, what it burns, and how bad a bad deploy is.

cluster.name: Kubernetes Cluster
cluster.blurb: Link App Servers or Workers into it. They pack onto shared nodes: 15% less Burn, copies in 30 s.

warehouse.name: Data Warehouse
warehouse.blurb: Answers report scans in columns. 1.5 s each, no limit, paid per scan.

vec.name: Vector Index
vec.blurb: Answers nearest-neighbour lookups over your embeddings. It holds the index in memory, and a prompt that reaches it earns more.

gpu.name: GPU Node
gpu.blurb: Serves AI prompts in tokens per second. Each size step doubles the GPUs.

edge.name: Edge Function
edge.blurb: Runs small handlers next to the user: 5 ms, no cold start, and a CPU ceiling instead of a box.

llm.name: LLM API
llm.blurb: Serves AI prompts with no GPUs. Paid per token, and rate limited.

msgp.name: Push Provider
msgp.blurb: Sends push notifications and email. Paid per message, 10,000 a second.

wide.name: Wide-column Store
wide.blurb: Replicates each key to N nodes. Reads ask R of them, writes wait for W.

dsql.name: Distributed SQL
dsql.blurb: SQL on Raft. Every write waits for a majority of its replicas.

cdc.name: CDC Connector
cdc.blurb: Link a Database into it. It reads every change off the write log and publishes it to an Event Stream, so the app never writes twice.

mesh.name: Service Mesh
mesh.blurb: Link App Servers and Workers into it. A sidecar beside each one retries and breaks its calls, and watches them: +1 ms a hop, and 5% of its CPU.

ff.name: Feature Flags
ff.blurb: Rolls a Feature out to 5%, 25%, 50% or every user, and turns it off in one click. A bad deploy reaches only the share that has it.

pki.name: Secrets and Certificates
pki.blurb: Holds the keys and renews the TLS certificates before they run out. Without it live, the certificate expires on the calendar and the site goes down.
